description: Marks exact order lines as purchased in HGR. The MCP resolves current WAPI status and uses FixedOrderLine only for CompletedAutoOrderPending. Requires confirmed=true after showing the full HGRWeb warning. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after showing the full HGRWeb warning: do not use this unless already purchased; it only marks the order as purchased in HGR; Auto-Ordering is required for automatic supplier purchase/shipping.

name: hgr_mark_order_lines_as_purchased
title: Mark Order Lines As Purchased
